title: A dashboard that tells you what to do next
changes: The dashboard now groups features by what you need to do: Needs setup first, then Ready, then everything that is still off
Features you have not enabled now show a full description of what they actually do, so you can find things you did not know the bot could do
The Getting Started guide no longer disappears the moment you set a log channel - it stays while anything is still unfinished, and now has a button that takes you straight to the next thing
Feature descriptions are the same everywhere now - the website, the dashboard overview and each settings page no longer say three different things
